name: @tasees/infra
description: Staging and demo environments for the Tasees platform in AWS me-central-1 (UAE), as code (AWS CDK).

scripts.synth:check: pnpm build && cdk synth --quiet -c domainName=staging.example.ae -c certificateArn=arn:aws:acm:me-central-1:111111111111:certificate/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 -c demoDomainName=demo.example.ae -c demoAllowedCidr=203.0.113.10/32 -c alarmEmail=alerts@example.ae
